_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. Features and new pages = entries with 1-3 short items (optional link, "shots": [...] — 2+ = carousel). Small changes = {"minor": true, date, category, title, optional link}: listed under the day, folded under a toggle when there are more than 3. Categories: Patch Reader, Materials, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site. Add an entry in the same commit as the change.

entries.title: Search, price and level fields use the pixel font for both the hint and what you type
Mana Items: what one point of Intelligence gives (+12 mana, +0.05 regen) sits in the toolbar again, hover for its patch history
Description paragraphs above the Materials tables are gone: the pages open straight on the controls
Tag chips (BUFF, NERF, NEW, DEL, REWORK, MISC, QOL) and group chips use the pixel font
Terrain toolbar buttons (Zoom, Fullscreen, map layers) match the new pixel buttons
Warm tones toned down: calmer, less yellow greys
The whole site switched from cold steel greys and blues to warm tones: panels, lines, table headers, calendar and its charts
Warm pixel controls
items: Menus, filter panels, buttons and switches are warm pixel UI now: pixel font, stepped corners, game-like buttons that turn gold when on
Melee, ranged and talent icons redrawn as gold pixel art

entries.title: The current Materials section glows warm from below, like the coals under the header's embers
Changelog
items: What's new on the site, by date — this page

entries.title: New header
items: The main buttons are plain labels; the page you're on glows gold over a thin bar with embers rising from it
The Materials sub-menu is a simple text row, the current page in gold

entries.title: Autocast as in the game
items: Autocast abilities on the neutral tables show Dota's own effect: a fiery glow runs round the icon, shedding embers

entries.title: New tile icons on the main page
items: Every tile has its own pixel icon; Dynamics and Changes show whether they're about heroes or items
Opening a category puts its name at the top

entries.title: AoE Increase shows every radius again (it was empty since 7.41f)
Innate abilities are read correctly for 7.41f heroes
Silent changes for 7.41f compare the right data
Change chips line up in one column everywhere, also inside ability boxes and item property panels
A changed item value shows its BUFF / NERF chip next to the new value
7.38 proofread: Tormentor, Lifesteal, Heaven's Halberd, Abyssal Blade and dozens of tags
Lists inside "?" popups show a bullet per line
The main page's "NEW" badge and the latest version in the header corner are gone
Clearer reworks and new things
items: Reworked mechanics and objectives read as one description of how they work now
Changed abilities get before/after cards with the real old tooltip
Values that grow with game time open a table by minute; new items read as a card
